Parse a single Rd object into an internal list

Source: R/parse_rd.R
dot-parse_rd_topic.Rd

Converts an Rd object (from either tools::Rd_db() or tools::parse_Rd()) into a flat list consumable by render_md.R. title/arguments[].name/arguments[].description/value are single-line-safe text via .rd_to_text() (Tier 2 - table cells and the page title can't contain a literal newline). description/ details/format/seealso/note/source/references/author/each section's body are full multi-paragraph Markdown via .rd_to_block_md() (Tier 3), since they commonly contain \\itemize{}, \\describe{}, \\subsection{}{}, etc. that Tier 2 would flatten into unreadable prose.

Usage

.parse_rd_topic(rd, rd_name, package, exported_names = NULL)

Arguments

rd

A single Rd object.

rd_name

Name of the Rd entry (list name from the Rd database, typically "function_name.Rd").

package

Name of the package this topic belongs to.

exported_names

Character vector of the package's exported names (see .read_exported_names()), or NULL if unknown. Drives is_private (see .compute_is_private()); has no other effect.

Value

A list with fields name, package, aliases, concepts, is_private, title, description, usage, arguments, details, sections, format, value, examples, seealso, note, source, references, author.
